_comment: gosec configuration, used by security_scan.sh in CI and locally.
G104 flags every call whose error is discarded. Writing the HTTP response
body is the one case where there is nothing to do with that error: the
status line and headers have already gone out, so the handler cannot turn a
failed write into a different status, and the only honest reaction is to
carry on. Whitelisting it here keeps the rule useful for the calls where
the error does mean something, instead of burying them under ~130 response
writes. Everywhere else the error is either handled or discarded
explicitly with `_ =`, which records the decision at the call site.
